answer: Sybil resistance via proof of continuous service: every agent identity is a pearl tied to one unique live endpoint it must keep serving, a small public data feed peers probe each epoch. Those probes form a vine of cross-checks: dead, duplicated, or shared endpoints are exposed and slashed. In an ocean of cheap keys, one honest agent runs one feed for pennies, but a farm of a thousand fakes must host, power, and maintain a thousand distinct live services, so each extra fake keeps costing real money and never gets free.
